# Mallan Real Estate Inc.
> Licensed NYC real estate brokerage. REBNY RLS participant.
> Specializing in residential sales and rentals across Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, and Staten Island.
> Principal Broker: Maya Allan.

## About
Mallan Real Estate Inc. is a full-service New York City real estate brokerage founded and led by Maya Allan, a Licensed Real Estate Broker with 21+ years of industry experience. The firm handles residential sales, rentals, and commercial properties across all five NYC boroughs, with particular expertise in Manhattan below 96th Street — including West Village, Upper East Side, Upper West Side, Midtown East, Midtown West, Chelsea, Tribeca, SoHo, Nolita, NoMad, NoHo, Gramercy Park, Flatiron, Greenwich Village, East Village, Financial District, Battery Park City, Kips Bay, Murray Hill, Lenox Hill, Carnegie Hill, Little Italy, Lower East Side, Chinatown, Civic Center, Sutton Place, Turtle Bay, Tudor City, Midtown South, Morningside Heights, Hell's Kitchen, Stuyvesant Town, Sugar Hill, Two Bridges, Union Square, Washington Heights, West Harlem, and Yorkville.

## International Clients
Mallan Real Estate advises buyers and owners outside the United States on Manhattan, Brooklyn, and Queens real estate. Common engagements include:
- Non-resident buyers acquiring condos, townhouses, or new-development apartments
- International owners deciding whether to sell, hold, or rent existing NYC property
- Pied-à-terre acquisition and entity-ownership (LLC, trust) coordination with the client's attorney
- FIRPTA-aware planning at sale (15% withholding on the gross sale price unless a reduction certificate is filed)
- Estate, relocation, and investment scenarios where the owner is abroad

Public international pages:
- https://mallan.nyc/buy/international — for international buyers
- https://mallan.nyc/sell/international — for international owners and sellers

Mallan Real Estate does not provide legal, tax, accounting, immigration, or financial-planning advice. All such advice must come from licensed professionals in the relevant jurisdiction. Mallan refers clients to NYC real estate attorneys and tax accountants familiar with non-resident matters.
